faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as an interior designer for office spaces in Karnal?

Yes. We design offices, clinics, showrooms with office areas and business centres in Karnal and nearby cities.

What does an office layout include?

Workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, reception, pantry, storage and washrooms, planned around your team size and how people work together.

Can you design an office inside a home?

Yes. Many business owners in Karnal run an office from part of their house. We give it a separate entry or zone so work and home stay apart.

Why hire an interior designer for office space instead of a contractor alone?

A designer plans light, comfort, privacy and future growth. A contractor builds what is drawn, so the planning decides how good the office will be.
